description: Angular component for configuring map action button settings, including form management, drag-and-drop reordering, and validation.

classes.name: MapActionButtonsSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a form for map action button settings with drag-and-drop and validation.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the form, returning errors if invalid.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Updates the form with provided button settings.

methods.name: addButton
methods.description: Adds a new default map action button to the form.

methods.name: removeButton
methods.description: Removes a button at specified index.

methods.name: dragEnabled
methods.description: Getter that returns true if drag-and-drop is enabled (more than one button).
